patterns.note: Full-width sections with strong visual separation, often achieved through distinct background colors or large, impactful imagery.
Dominant use of an extremely bold, condensed sans-serif typeface for all primary headings and titles, creating a powerful and almost brutalist typographic statement.
Strategic use of a vibrant purple as a primary accent and background color for key hero and content sections, providing high contrast against black text and white/light grey backgrounds.
A transforming sticky header where the initial large site title shrinks and integrates into the main navigation bar as the user scrolls down the page.
Content is organized into clearly delineated blocks, each introduced by a large, uppercase typographic heading, often set against a contrasting background color.

technique_notes: The site's main navigation and branding are initially presented as an oversized hero element. Upon scrolling, this hero section collapses, and the site's primary title shrinks and repositions to form a compact, sticky navigation bar at the top of the viewport.

Typographic hierarchy is established through the consistent application of an extremely bold, condensed display font for all major headings and calls to action, creating a distinct visual identity that contrasts sharply with the more subtle body text.

Visual segmentation of content is achieved by using full-width background color blocks, primarily a vibrant purple or a light blue, to create clear divisions between different sections and add visual dynamism.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed, and bold headings (~4-5x body text) create a dramatic visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif for body copy and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently throughout the design, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but tighter line-heights for the bold headings to maintain visual density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely bold, condensed typography for all major headings, combined with a transforming sticky header that integrates the site title, creates a powerful and memorable visual identity. The vibrant purple color blocking further reinforces this modern, almost brutalist aesthetic.
